stimulus.source_note: Original summary sentence; the Reconquista ended with the fall of Granada in January 1492.
stimulus.text: Spanish conquistadors described their campaigns in the language of holy war, seeking gold, glory, and royal favor in the name of the Catholic faith.

stem: In January 1492 the Catholic Monarchs took Granada, ending the Reconquista. In October 1492 Columbus landed in the Caribbean. What does the pairing of these two events in the same year best show about Spain in 1492?

options.misconception: Ignores the record; Spain took Granada by war and sailed the same year, not at peace.
options.text: Spain was a kingdom at peace with no military ambitions left

options.misconception: Mixes up the ending of one war with the end of war; the crusading habit carried into the Americas.
options.text: Spain's religious wars had ended, so Spain had no reason to sail
Spain was a crown fresh from holy war, ready to carry its mission overseas

options.misconception: Puts conquest before contact; no Spaniard had reached the Americas before Columbus sailed.
options.text: Spain had already conquered the Americas and needed no voyage to reach them

instruction: Answer from the stimulus and stem only. Pick one option. Do not open the question file.
